name: learn-to-design
title_zh: 需求到设计图的陪练，关键架构决策留给你拍板
tagline_zh: 怕 Agent 替你拍板、练不出真功夫？它只出候选方案和权衡。
tagline_en: Scared of agents deciding for you? It offers options and tradeoffs, keeps final architecture calls yours—like a.
desc_en: Practice turning requirements into technical designs without having the agent make the important architectural decisions for you.
why_zh: 它不替你决策，而是逼你把需求拆成可讨论的设计选项，在每步追问里练出你自己的架构判断力。
why_en: It won't decide for you. Instead, it forces requirements into discussable options, sharpening your judgment through every.
limit_zh: 只覆盖需求到技术设计的早期推演，不产出代码、不画架构图；需要你已有基本技术背景，否则追问会卡在术语上。
limit_en: Covers only early requirement-to-design reasoning. No code, no diagrams. Requires basic technical literacy or its questions stall on jargon.
title_en: Practice turning requirements into designs, with you.
